source.title: Editor: Screen reader labels in the AI builder chat are hardcoded English

labels.name: status:in-linear
labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body:
### Bug Description

In the AI builder chat, four screen reader labels are written in English straight into the code, so screen reader users hear them in English even when the UI is set to another language:

- "Workflow execution panel", the panel the builder shows after it creates a workflow, so you can set it up and run it.
- "Workflow validation issues", the list of problems the builder found in that workflow.
- "Workflow setup wizard", the step-by-step setup inside that panel.
- "More approval options", the arrow button next to "Always allow" when the builder asks to fetch a web page. It opens the other choices, such as "Allow once".

https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/28b1d8ad1ac3ac2ad0db6f2f4e616926996a8807/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/features/ai/assistant/components/Agent/ExecuteMessage.vue#L230

https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/28b1d8ad1ac3ac2ad0db6f2f4e616926996a8807/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/features/ai/assistant/components/Agent/ExecuteMessage.vue#L257

https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/28b1d8ad1ac3ac2ad0db6f2f4e616926996a8807/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/features/ai/assistant/components/Agent/BuilderSetupWizard.vue#L195

https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/blob/28b1d8ad1ac3ac2ad0db6f2f4e616926996a8807/packages/frontend/editor-ui/src/features/ai/assistant/components/Agent/WebFetchApprovalMessage.vue#L95

The visible text in these parts, such as "Always allow" and "Deny", already uses `aiAssistant.builder.*` keys.

### To Reproduce

1. Set the UI to a language other than English.
2. Open a workflow and open the AI builder chat.
3. Ask the builder to create a workflow.
4. When it is done, inspect the panel under the last message with a screen reader or the browser dev tools. Its `aria-label` is "Workflow execution panel" in English.

### Expected behavior

The screen reader labels use the selected language, like the visible text around them.

### Debug Info

I found this while reading the code on `master` (2.49.0). The text is written into the code, so it happens on every setup.

### Environment

- Operating System: macOS (platform independent)
- n8n Version: 2.49.0 (`master`)
- Node.js Version: 24.x
- Database: n/a
- Execution mode: n/a

### Note

I have a fix ready and will open a PR.
